title: SR-0.03 Verify runs every verifier type the specs use: red-green tests, metrics and scope, behind the same local gates as commands
request: Closes G85 (found 30 October 2026 while checking the WBS runbook against the code): memev verify runs only command, file_exists, test_exists and grep (src/engine/contracts.mjs:224-235); test_red_green, metric and scope criteria return BLOCKED as checked by a person or CI, so 213 of the 340 seed-readiness criteria (scope 118, test_red_green 64, metric 31) cannot PASS through the tool the WBS names, and no task of the 85 contracts can reach PASS because the attest lint requires a scope criterion per task. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none. Sequenced with SR-1.02: both change the command-execution path of contracts.mjs, so the local-approval gate of SR-1.02 covers the new verifiers (red-green and metric spawn commands exactly as command criteria do and inherit every gate: remote-signed needs approval, exec_local_only, contracts.exec). Security checklist for this change (who can call: any holder of a read token over MCP or the CLI, as for verify today; what runs: the contract's own commands in its workdir, and the red run in a detached temporary worktree of the recorded base; what survives a restart: the base sha inside the signed contract, and temporary worktrees are removed in a finally block and pruned at the next run; two processes: each verify creates its own temporary worktree under its own name, and the green run is the contract's own command as today).

tasks.title: Base revision recorded at signing
requirements: contractSign records base = { sha, recorded_at } from git rev-parse HEAD of the contract's workdir when the workdir is a git checkout, before the DSSE signature is made, so the signature covers it
memev contract new accepts an explicit base sha in the spec and refuses a value that is not 40 hex characters
a scope or test_red_green criterion of a contract without a recorded base returns BLOCKED with the detail no base revision recorded, never PASS
docs/CONTRACTS.md documents the base and where verify reads it
command, metric and red-green commands run with MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE set to the recorded base sha in their environment, so a criterion can name the base (the mutation gate of QL-1.02 reads it)

criteria.statement: Signing in a git workdir records the base sha and a signed contract without one gets BLOCKED on its scope criterion
The contracts page documents the base revision

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Scope verifier
requirements: a scope criterion lists the files changed between the recorded base and the working tree of the workdir (git diff --name-status with renames, plus untracked files not ignored) and matches each against the task's scope globs with the vendored matchAny
any changed file outside the globs is FAIL with the files named; no changed files or all inside is PASS with the count; a workdir that is not a git checkout is BLOCKED
the receipt path contracts/ inside the vault is never part of the comparison when the workdir is the vault itself

criteria.statement: A seeded change outside the task's globs fails the scope criterion and a change inside passes it

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Red-green verifier
requirements: a test_red_green criterion requires the test file to exist in the workdir, adds a detached temporary worktree of the recorded base, copies the test file and any support_files into it, runs the command with {test} substituted there (red) and in the workdir (green)

red exit 0 is FAIL (the test passes without the change and proves nothing); green non-zero is FAIL; exit 127 is BLOCKED (command not found); otherwise PASS, and the detail carries both exit codes and the base sha
the temporary worktree is removed in a finally block, and stale ones from an interrupted run are pruned before a new one is added

every gate that applies to a command criterion applies here: remote-signed without approval, exec_local_only and contracts.exec return the same BLOCKED details; the default timeout is 900 s and timeout_s overrides it

criteria.statement: A fixture whose test fails on the base and passes on the head gets PASS; one whose test passes on the base gets FAIL; a remote-signed unapproved contract gets BLOCKED; no worktree is left behind

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Metric verifier
requirements: a metric criterion runs its command under the same gates as a command criterion, reads the last JSON object on stdout (or the file named by output_file), picks key as a dotted path and compares with op in <, <=, >, >= and == against value

no JSON, a missing key or a non-numeric value is FAIL with the detail; exit 127 is BLOCKED; a 1-minute load per CPU above the contract's defaults.max_load_per_cpu, when set, is BLOCKED as machine busy and the command is not run
the detail records the measured value, the threshold, the CPU count and the load, so a reading on other hardware is labelled

criteria.statement: A bench stub whose value meets the threshold passes, one that misses fails with the measured value in the detail, and a busy-machine setting blocks without running the command

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Behaviour apart from documents in every report
requirements: the verify result, the receipt and the CLI line count behaviour criteria (command, test_red_green, metric, scope) apart from document checks (grep, file_exists, test_exists), printing behaviour n/m and documents n/m per task
ok still requires every mandatory criterion to PASS; a task whose only passing criteria are document checks is reported as documents only and never as done
docs/CONTRACTS.md states that document checks never count toward done on their own

criteria.statement: A contract with one passing grep and one failing red-green test is reported documents only, not done
The contracts page says document checks never count toward done on their own
